* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 21 release sheet (first edition, June 2023)<ref name="sheet21-20230617">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet, June 2023 edition] (PDF, 8 pages, footer “”; file created 17 June 2023). Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny &gt; defense value.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Asajj Ventress' Lightsabers]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Asajj Ventress' Lightsabers]] (published 18 June 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Asajj Ventress’ Lightsabers”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip).
